definitions.profit: accrual: revenue recognised by stage minus all costs incl. owner draw, taxes, interest, risk events and mitigation costs; cumulative from month 1
definitions.ran_out_of_cash: cash + approved credit line < 0 in any month (the line exists only with mitigation R09); trials continue on emergency money at emergency_financing_rate so the size of the hole is visible
definitions.capital_need: starting capital minus the lowest cash balance = own money that would have kept cash >= 0 in that trial
definitions.breakeven_month: first month in which cumulative profit >= 0 (99 = not within 24)
